cuisine.kibris_en_desc: Traditional Cypriot recipes with precise measurements: halloumi dishes, sheftalia, kleftiko, kolokas and flaouna, tested step by step.
cuisine.kibris_en_faq_1_a: Halloumi, sheftalia (Cypriot meatballs in caul fat), slow-roasted kleftiko lamb, molehiya stew, taro-root kolokas and Easter flaouna pastries are among the best-known dishes of Cyprus. House Chef Cyprus documents each with tested measurements and steps.
cuisine.kibris_en_faq_heading: Frequently asked questions about Cypriot food
cuisine.kibris_en_faq_1_q: What are the most famous Cypriot dishes?
cuisine.kibris_en_faq_2_a: This archive publishes tested, verified traditional Cypriot recipes in English, with metric measurements, times and step-by-step instructions.
cuisine.kibris_en_faq_2_q: Where can I find traditional Cypriot recipes in English?
cuisine.kibris_en_faq_3_a: No. Sheftalia (often written seftali kebab) contains no peach: seasoned minced meat with onion, parsley and spices is wrapped in caul fat and grilled.

home.trust_editorial_date_text: Every recipe shows when it was last reviewed by editors; if unreviewed, that is also transparently stated.

home.trust_home_measurements_text: When servings scale, amounts update proportionally with recorded conversion accuracy.
